name: 42-google-tool-call-round-trip
description: The tool path of convertGooglePrompt. An assistant turn carrying `tool_calls` becomes one part of type 'tool_calls' (:475-477); each call becomes a functionCall whose args go through `tryParse(...) ?? ...arguments` (:554) and whose `signature` is spread onto the part only when truthy (:556); every call id is recorded in toolNameMap (:559). The two following 'tool' turns become role 'user' (:462-463) holding a 'tool_call_id' part, whose functionResponse name is looked up in toolNameMap -- 'call_1' resolves to 'get_weather' while 'call_missing' falls back to 'unknown' (:542) -- and the second one merges into the first, because a functionResponse part is re-pushed during a merge (:610-611). Model 'gemini-2.5-pro' is inside the signature guard (:577) but no message carries a signature, so nothing is injected (:595: Gemini 2.5 needs no bypass). Expected: contents = [user[text], model[functionCall+thoughtSignature 'SIG-TOOL', functionCall(args='not-json{')], user[functionResponse get_weather, functionResponse unknown], model[text 'It is sunny.' + thoughtSignature 'SIG-TEXT']]; the last turn's signature comes from the injected message-level `signature`, and the first call's args parse back to the object {'city':'Tokyo'}.
